shared_elements: carved upright slab format with a single framed scene
justification: Both show an upright commemorative slab with human figures in profile, one apparently seated with objects/offerings placed in front, and rows of dense script-like signs occupying registers (columns beside the figures in A, horizontal bands below in B). The conventions of depiction differ sharply, however: A's figure is elaborately ornamented with dense, deeply carved regalia and glyph blocks filling every space, while B uses spare, thin outline drawing of slender figures with a curved-top field and clean, empty ground.
